name: extend_attention
description: extend_attention(q_extend, k_extend, v_extend, k_buffer, v_buffer, qo_indptr, kv_indptr, kv_indices, max_len_extend) -> output. q_extend is [E, H_Q, D], k_extend/v_extend are [E, H_KV, D], and k_buffer/v_buffer are [total_tokens, H_KV, D]. qo_indptr and kv_indptr have length B+1. For each request, gather prefix K/V rows from k_buffer/v_buffer using kv_indices[kv_indptr[i]:kv_indptr[i+1]], append the corresponding extend K/V rows, repeat KV heads across H_Q/H_KV, and apply causal masking over the combined prefix+extend sequence. Softmax is scaled by 1/sqrt(D); the result is the weighted sum of V. Returns a newly allocated float32 tensor with shape [E, H_Q, v_buffer.shape[-1]]. max_len_extend is accepted for ABI compatibility but is not used by the native computation. No input mutation. Exercised inputs are bfloat16.
